description: This file defines a SettingsRepository class for managing application settings such as theme mode and notification preferences, using SharedPreferences for persistence.

classes.name: _PrefsKeys
classes.description: A private class containing static constants for the keys used to store and retrieve settings in SharedPreferences.

classes.name: SettingsRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to get and set user settings like theme mode and notification preference, persisting them in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getThemeMode
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current theme mode setting, defaulting to 'system' if not set.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the specified theme mode ('system', 'light', or 'dark') to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves whether notifications are enabled, defaulting to true.

methods.name: setNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the notifications enabled real in SharedPreferences.
